learnings.question: What psychological phenomenon describes the tendency of the brain to immediately forget information once it is recorded or stored digitally?
learnings.learning: The 'Performance Paradox' of Cognitive Offloading (or Digital Amnesia) occurs because the brain treats writing something down or storing it on a device as permission to delete that information from memory.
learnings.articleTitle: Is Your Brain the Worst Place to Store Ideas? Why I Built a Second One

learnings.question: What standard structure is used to format a User Story within a Scrum Product Backlog?
options: As a [role], I need [feature], so that [reason]
learnings.learning: In Scrum, user stories in the Product Backlog are structured using the standard template: 'As a [role], I need [feature], so that [reason].'

learnings.question: In Islamic philosophy, beyond performing standard rituals, which internal quality does worship specifically foster to build self-restraint and deter wrongdoing?
learnings.learning: Worship in Islam extends beyond mere ritual performance; its foundational purpose is to cultivate taqwa (mindfulness and awareness of Allah), which builds self-restraint and purifies human intentions.

learnings.question: What primary trade-off occurs when transitioning a PCIe device into deeper power-saving states such as L1.2 or L2?
options: Energy savings are maximized, but the device requires a significantly longer wake-up time to resume activity.
The link remains fully active, but voltage output is permanently decreased.
Data transmission speeds increase, but the device generates higher operational heat.
Wake-up delays are eliminated, but data packet loss becomes significantly higher.
learnings.learning: While entering deeper PCIe power-saving states like L1.2 and L2 maximizes energy conservation, it introduces the challenge of increased wake-up delays before the device can resume active operation.
learnings.articleTitle: Power Management States in the context of PCIe

learnings.question: What concept refers to Allah's complete, preordained plan and eternal knowledge of everything that will ever happen?
learnings.learning: Qadr represents Allah's complete and eternal plan encompassing everything that will ever happen, whereas Qada' refers to the actual unfolding of events in life that can be altered by supplication and human actions.
learnings.articleTitle: The Art of Qada’ and Qadr
